contribution.summary: Establish the bounded M0-W01-C01 .NET 10 foundation with locked restore, targeted tests, package creation, helper boundary checks, and isolated local package consumption.
contribution.value: Creates the first independently verifiable Math package/toolchain slice without AURA or math-provider dependencies and proves the repository can restore, build, test, pack, and consume its output reproducibly.
debtChanges: CI automation remains deferred until the foundation chain is durably delivered; no package publication or external repository mutation is introduced.

The initial native DWF bootstrap compressed M0-W01-C01 product task granularity. Before any successor implementation run, reconcile the complete accepted Astra backlog hierarchy into the native DWF plan without changing product intent.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS001 success, reconcile the complete accepted Astra backlog into the native DWF plan before preparing RS002, preserving stable IDs, hierarchy, dependencies, and product meaning; then use M0-W01-C02 to validate the adoption and mapping.

achievements.achievement: The reproducible .NET 10 foundation contract is implemented and verified through locked restore, build, targeted MSTest execution, package creation, helper boundary checks, and isolated local package consumption.

M0-W01-C01 is verified as a complete foundation slice: the pinned toolchain, package boundary, PowerShell behavior, test path, pack path, and isolated consumer all pass without AURA or provider dependencies.
